ev.title: DestinyGuide - Events
ev.heading: Events
ev.lead: Destiny runs a seasonal event every few weeks, and each one adds items, a limited quest, or a shop trade that disappears when it ends. This page collects what each event contained, when it ran, and how its rewards were obtained.
ev.source: Source: the event announcement channels on the Destiny Discord, posted by GM VEL(JP). Drop rates are the values announced at the time and may have been adjusted since.
ev.summer26.a: Ran for four weeks from 16 July 2026.
ev.anniv8.q1: Some enemy spawns were modified from the regular version.
ev.anniv8.q2: Secret bosses dropped RADIANT RING in place of their usual drop.
ev.anniv8.q3: The secret room was made harder to reach than in the 7th Anniversary version.
ev.anniv8.t1: for Anniversary Crate x60, during the event only
ev.anniv8.t2: A dedicated trade NPC accepted Anniversary Crates, and was available only while the event ran.
ev.anniv8.t3: The Anniversary Crate item list was adjusted for this run.
ev.anniv8.after: RADIANT RING was announced for the regular drop table later on, but at a lower rate than during the event.
ev.anniv8.leaderboard: SS rank clear teams were recorded on the Discord leaderboard channel.
ev.hw.a: A revival run held between the Easter event and the 8th Anniversary event.
ev.hw.b: It started after a server restart and ran until the 8th Anniversary event began.
ev.easter26.rateAdj: The rate started at 1/64 and was raised to 1/55 partway through the event.
ev.easter26.c1: Easter versions of quests were available under EP1 / EP2 > Easter.
ev.easter26.o1: DIVINE FIELD was added to the Millennium Shop.
ev.easter26.o2: The Add Special NPC now warns you before applying a special that would not work - for example when making a Hell Dark Flow.
ev.easter26.o3: BERSERK NEEDLE was announced for the regular drop table later on, at a lower rate.
ev.valentine26.yearRoundNote: unlike the rest of the event, it did not disappear when the event ended.
ev.valentine26.o1: The Valentine Crate item list was adjusted.
ev.valentine26.o2: Bubbles had its DFP and EFR lowered.
ev.valentine26.o3: Adding a special by redeeming Flower Bouquets was disabled for this run.
ev.valentine26.o4: The event was extended by one day to make up for a server restart and hotfixes.
ev.xmas25.b1: and free Section ID changes, for the entire event.
ev.xmas25.b2: Parasitic Gene 'Flow' dropped at an improved rate of 1/146.
ev.xmas25.c1: Every monster in Ragol had a chance to drop Christmas Presents and Photon Tokens.
ev.xmas25.c2: used to add hit to weapons by speaking to Paganini in the Phantastic Bazaar quest.
ev.xmas25.c3: could contain limited edition Xmas apparel, certain Type Weapons with a special, or a Yasminkov 9000m with a special.
ev.xmas25.s1: Launches a volley of 3 candy canes per shot at a single target.
ev.xmas25.s2: special - hits moving and flying targets without missing.
ev.xmas25.s3: Equippable by Hunter, Ranger and Force.
ev.xmas25.orb: can be used on certain gear to change its appearance and name. Everything else about the item stays identical to the original.
ev.xmas25.q1: A Mines 1-2 quest with a good number of enemies.
ev.xmas25.q2: Clear reward: any three materials, including TP and Luck materials.
ev.xmas25.q3: Remember to activate all four consoles in Mines 1.
ev.cycle.title: The yearly cycle
ev.cycle.lead: Events repeat on a rough annual pattern, so you can plan around them. Dates shift year to year, and revival runs are sometimes slotted between the regular ones.
ev.sameAs2025: Contents are the same as the 2025 run
ev.sameAsNote: everything below is from that event, which is what the announcement points to.
ev.summer.boost1: and free Section ID changes for the whole event - use /sectionid in game to switch.
ev.summer.token: Photon Tokens drop from any monster and are spent in the Phantastic Bazaar quest (EP2 > Shop) to add hit to a weapon, up to a maximum of 80.
ev.summer.bpNote: From the 2025 run onward, every Section ID can drop the Blueprint.
ev.summer.dorphon: Dorphon Divine appears only in Summer Vacation Tragedy.
ev.summer.role: clear with under 20 deaths and within 40 minutes.
ev.summer.redNote: immune to Demon's and Hell, and carries a damage-cut barrier unless it is a boss.
ev.summer.yearRound: Beyond the Nightmare and Beyond the Mainframe were introduced during this event as year-round quests.
ev.hw.rates: Rates shown are the adjusted values. During the run BAT WING went from 1/930 to 1/730, Astral Essence from 1/1760 to 1/1400, and Ill Gill Reaper from 1/1024 to 1/930.
ev.hw.new1: Harmony of Despair II [Halloween] was added, giving Headless Horseman a second quest to farm BAT WINGS in.
ev.hw.new2: Grim Reaper Ethereal Armor drop was replaced with LAST EMPEROR.
ev.hw.new3: Room IDs for some enemies in the Halloween Path to Salvation were corrected, so it spawns more enemies than the regular version.
ev.hw.new4: A bank was added to Path to Salvation [Halloween] and the laser fence in Ruins 1 was removed.
